posts.text:
Tuesday, Nov 3: Toronto's streetcars lost 976 hours to delays, across all routes.

Hardest hit: 501 Queen westbound, where the typical trip lost 37 min.
Smoothest: 507 Long Branch eastbound, 12 min.

https://freems88.github.io/ttc-streetcar-delays/

Tuesday's slowest spot: Westbound on Fleet St, approaching Fort York Blvd.
The average streetcar lost 2 min 1 s here. Across 303 trips, that adds up to 10.2 hours.
This signal has transit priority.
posts.alt: 3D map of Fleet St around Fort York Blvd, rotated to Toronto's street grid. Delay is drawn as a coloured ridge above the track, rising where streetcars lose time; the westbound stretch at Fort York Blvd is highlighted, peaking at about 2 min 1 s lost per streetcar.

shot.title: Fleet St westbound, approaching Fort York Blvd
shot.sub: Tuesday, Nov 3: 2 min 1 s lost per streetcar · 303 trips

posts.text:
Tuesday, Nov 3: bunching and missing cars added 1.4 min to the average wait at a stop on frequent routes.

Worst: 512 St Clair eastbound, 1.7 min extra; 1 in 4 cars bunched.
Steadiest: 511 Bathurst northbound, 0.4 min extra.

https://freems88.github.io/ttc-streetcar-delays/#v=wait

Most held at a signal, Tuesday, Nov 3: eastbound at Fort York Blvd & Fleet St.

1 in 3 streetcars waited 90 s or more beyond a clean approach, about a full signal cycle, despite transit priority.
About 303 streetcars came through.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Fort York Blvd & Fleet St, with arrows for each direction of streetcar travel into each signal, coloured by how often streetcars were held 90 seconds or more. A tooltip for the eastbound approach reads 35% held 90 s+, with a histogram of extra time through the approach.

posts.text:
Tuesday, Nov 3: at the busiest moment (6:00 pm), 151 streetcars were in service, against 151 scheduled.
Overall, 100% of scheduled streetcar service ran, and buses ran 1,017 hours on streetcar routes.

Service changes, Tuesday, Nov 3:
• 501 Queen, partly by bus: Route change
• 504 King, partly by bus: Temporary service change due to City of Toronto work
• 506 Carlton, partly by bus: No service between High Park Loop and College…
